propositions: Running the documented curl command from a linked worktree resolves to and overwrites the shared hooks directory in the main checkout, clobbering the pre-commit wrapper for all worktrees on the host
The curl installation silently breaks Change-Id stamping when it replaces the pre-commit wrapper, causing Gerrit push rejections that appear only later in different worktrees
The documented bare curl installation is unsafe and must be replaced with a single idempotent documented path (make hooks) that preserves the pre-commit/Gerrit hook chain
The new scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh script must be cwd-independent, non-destructive, idempotent, and refuse unsafe overwrites of non-wrapper hooks with loud error messages
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove instructions to curl directly over git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg
A test must verify that after the documented install, commits receive both Change-Id stamping and pre-commit commit-msg gate validation
